name: Haus Elisengrund
beschreibung:
Nestled amid green pastures in Seefeld in Tirol, Haus Elisengrund offers well-appointed holiday apartments for a restful stay in the Alps.

Seefeld cable cars, Olympic cross-country ski trails, and the village center are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Elisengrund in Seefeld provides peaceful accommodation on the sunny Seefeld high plateau.
